+func TestLoadDefaultsAndEnvironment(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Setenv("FLIPT_LOG_LEVEL", "")
+	t.Setenv("FLIPT_SERVER_HTTP_PORT", "")
+
+	defaults, err := Load("")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, Default().Log.Level, defaults.Config.Log.Level)
+	assert.Equal(t, Default().Server.HTTPPort, defaults.Config.Server.HTTPPort)
+
+	t.Setenv("FLIPT_LOG_LEVEL", "debug")
+	t.Setenv("FLIPT_SERVER_HTTP_PORT", "8088")
+
+	result, err := Load("")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "debug", result.Config.Log.Level)
+	assert.Equal(t, 8088, result.Config.Server.HTTPPort)
+}
+
+func TestLoadFileAndEnvironmentPrecedence(t *testing.T) {
+	path := t.TempDir() + "/flipt.yml"
+	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, []byte("log:\n  level: WARN\nserver:\n  http_port: 8181\n"), 0600))
+
+	t.Setenv("FLIPT_LOG_LEVEL", "")
+	t.Setenv("FLIPT_SERVER_HTTP_PORT", "")
+
+	fromFile, err := Load(path)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "WARN", fromFile.Config.Log.Level)
+	assert.Equal(t, 8181, fromFile.Config.Server.HTTPPort)
+
+	t.Setenv("FLIPT_LOG_LEVEL", "debug")
+	t.Setenv("FLIPT_SERVER_HTTP_PORT", "8088")
+
+	result, err := Load(path)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, "debug", result.Config.Log.Level)
+	assert.Equal(t, 8088, result.Config.Server.HTTPPort)
+}
